about: View Royal is a town on southern Vancouver Island in Greater Victoria, between Esquimalt Harbour and Thetis Lake country—not Victoria itself. Harbour shores, Thetis Lake Regional Park approaches, and suburban neighbourhoods along the Island Highway define the community. About 12,000 people live in View Royal.
